content.short: Reclaim Protocol enables users to generate verified credentials from any website on the internet.
content.description: Reclaim Protocol has built zkTLS infrastructure that lets users generate verified credentials backed by zero-knowledge proofs without requiring an app installation. This technology is applied to a broad set of use cases, including Decentralized Identifiers (DID), Proof of Personhood, Reputation Systems, Secondary KYC (Know Your Customer) processes, verified credentials, and credit scores, showcasing the versatility of zkTLS for identity and credentialing across Web3 contexts.
content.meta: Reclaim Protocol uses zkTLS to issue credentials backed by ZK proofs, no app install. Discover Reclaim Protocol and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
